chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 478: Han Li Tests the Bronze Rings & Blood Cloak Before the Illusory Mirage
chapter_meta_description: Han Li stops to test two ancient treasures before entering the Ultimate Illusory Mirage. One is an assassination-grade weapon; the other is a broken but deadly escape tool.
og_title: Chapter 478 – Stirring the Seas from Afar, The Anomalous Ancient Treasure
og_description: Before stepping into the Illusory Mirage, Han Li tests his new gear. The bronze rings are terrifyingly invisible. The blood cloak? Fast, but broken.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 478: Han Li’s Gear Check
twitter_description: Han Li tests two ancient treasures before the mirage. One is perfect for ambushes. The other is a last-resort speed escape.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational mental cultivation technique that strengthens divine sense and enables advanced mental defense against illusions.
A protective artifact lent to Han Li by Extreme Yin, likely providing resistance against mental or soul attacks.
A magic weapon from an ancient era, distinct from modern tools; often possesses unique or unpredictable properties.
The second major trial zone in the Void Heaven Palace, known for testing a cultivator's mental fortitude with beautiful but deadly illusions.
A newly acquired ancient treasure; can turn invisible, form a defensive barrier, and teleport onto a target's limbs to immobilize them.
A flawed top-grade ancient treasure that grants extreme speed at the cost of control and massive mana drain.
Illusory elements of the mirage trial designed to lull cultivators into a false sense of peace before springing a trap.
